claims.text: Reviewers frequently say the product strengthens nails and helps them grow longer, with many reporting reduced splitting and breaking.
Many reviewers praise how quickly it dries and how easy it is to apply.
Several reviewers note it goes on clear despite looking pink in the bottle and works well as a top coat or with a French manicure finish.
A few reviewers mention it lasts a long time but tends to yellow by the second week, so they recommend reapplying after about 10 days.
Some reviewers note the price is a plus, though one warns it can be found cheaper elsewhere.
